observations.text: The resort presents accommodation, gaming, dining, entertainment, spa, pools and loyalty as parts of one broader Venetian Resort environment.
Public material also exposes relationship-specific products including Prestige, hotel-guest-only pool access, Canyon Ranch day passes and conditional TAO Beach hotel-guest benefits.

observations.text: Hotel reservations carry rate, cancellation, resort-fee, check-in, checkout and availability conditions, while larger accommodation groups are routed to Group Sales.
Dining can involve reservations, walk-ins or separate group arrangements, while cabanas, daybeds, spa access and other products create additional reservation relationships.
Third-party hotel bookings are distinguished from direct reservations in the operator's published hotel guidance.

dimensions.reason: Several separate commitment mechanisms are documented, but their interaction with shared resort capacity and service recovery is not fully established.
unanswered: The inspected sources do not establish whether different resort products share reservation infrastructure or capacity controls.
Complete cancellation, no-show, modification and denied-service rules are not established across all resort relationships.

observations.text: Hotel check-in requires the coded guest, valid identification and the booking credit card, while deposit and incidental requirements can vary by reservation and suite type.
Prestige, Venetian Rewards, TAO Beach and other resort relationships can require different proofs of entitlement, including upgraded booking status, loyalty tier or valid suite-key verification.
Dining, spa and other venue conditions can add age, dress, reservation or product-specific requirements before use.

dimensions.question: What must different resort users know, possess or verify before arrival, and how much does preparation depend on their specific resort relationship?
dimensions.reason: Several relationship-specific prerequisites are visible, but complete pre-arrival communication and exception handling remain under-specified.
unanswered: The current source set does not establish how consistently entitlement restrictions are communicated in confirmations and reminders.
Recovery when a guest arrives without the correct credential, tier status, reservation or venue eligibility remains incomplete.

observations.text: Hotel arrival uses formal check-in requirements, while Prestige adds private check-in and concierge service.
Other resort environments use different arrival proofs: hotel status for the Venetian Pool Deck, valid suite-key conditions at TAO Beach and product-specific access at Canyon Ranch.

observations.text: An ordinary hotel stay does not create uniform entitlement across the resort: the pool requires hotel-guest status, Prestige adds exclusive benefits, and TAO Beach hotel-guest entry remains conditional.
Venetian Rewards tier status can add benefits such as upgrades, priority, late checkout, transport and other cross-resort advantages.
Canyon Ranch can serve both hotel and non-hotel guests through separate access relationships.

Ending the hotel stay does not necessarily end loyalty membership or every independent resort relationship.
Venue, dining and spa relationships can have their own temporal boundaries independent of hotel checkout.
